tools.name: Toolbay Flow
tools.tagline: Talk, and your words appear wherever you're typing.
tools.description: Hold a key, say what you want to write, and let go. Toolbay Flow turns your voice into clean text in any app: email, chat, documents, the browser. It runs on your own computer, so what you say stays private, and it works without an account.
